title: Typed fact directory

body: This directory exposes existing typed records. Preserve source IDs, scope and qualifications; absent evidence stays absent.

children.title: corominas.multi_tenant.problem.1
children.summary: A 200-client operation needed repeatable delivery without client-specific code branches.

children.title: corominas.multi_tenant.action.2
children.summary: Built a configuration-driven, multi-tenant LLM pipeline from intake through validation, approval, publication, confirmation, and state tracking.

children.title: corominas.multi_tenant.output.3
children.summary: Converted client onboarding and variation into configuration instead of duplicated workflow logic.

children.title: corominas.multi_tenant.outcome.4
children.summary: Rolled the client-deliverable and approval cycle across the full 200-client portfolio while retaining exception handling and final approval.

children.title: corominas.llm_harness.action.1
children.summary: Built provider-independent LLM orchestration with sub-agent techniques, prompt caching, context management, loop reduction, and memory optimization.

children.title: corominas.llm_harness.output.2
children.summary: Separated model-provider calls from orchestration so a model change became configuration rather than a workflow rewrite.

children.title: corominas.llm_harness.outcome.3
children.summary: Reduced inference cost by more than 90 percent, from dollar-scale to cent-scale per operation, without quality regression.

children.title: corominas.quality_gate.action.1
children.summary: Built a deterministic validation layer between generation and human review for format, completeness, factual consistency, and structure.

children.title: corominas.quality_gate.output.2
children.summary: Withheld failed output and made prompt or model changes comparable against stable checks.

children.title: corominas.quality_gate.outcome.3
children.summary: Automated routine validation while preserving final human judgment.

children.title: corominas.approval.action.1
children.summary: Built a client-facing preview, inline-editing, approval, publication, and confirmation flow.

children.title: corominas.approval.output.2
children.summary: Made approval a defined client-controlled state transition rather than an informal team handoff.

children.title: corominas.approval.outcome.3
children.summary: Reduced approval-to-publish time from days to under 60 seconds.

children.title: corominas.agent_ops.action.1
children.summary: Built domain-specific agents across Slack with an Airtable ledger for queryable actions and human escalation for cross-system risk.

children.title: corominas.agent_ops.output.2
children.summary: Separated routine autonomous requests from risky changes that required a human ticket.

children.title: corominas.agent_ops.outcome.3
children.summary: Removed a routine engineering bottleneck and replaced ad hoc status chasing with visible notifications and durable history.

children.title: corominas.generated_workflows.action.1
children.summary: Built Python generators that emit and maintain workflow definitions as deterministic infrastructure.

children.title: corominas.generated_workflows.output.2
children.summary: Made workflow patterns reviewable, reproducible, and consistently regenerable.

children.title: corominas.generated_workflows.outcome.3
children.summary: Replaced repeated manual workflow editing with reusable generation logic.

children.title: corominas.security_response.action.1
children.summary: Led a technical response to a third-party compromise by identifying the vector, auditing automation, sweeping the portfolio, and hardening the API surface.

children.title: corominas.security_response.output.2
children.summary: Converted the portfolio sweep into a passive ongoing scanner and authored a standing security policy.

children.title: corominas.security_response.outcome.3
children.summary: Turned a one-off incident investigation into an ongoing posture-monitoring control.

children.title: formula.event_pipeline.problem.1
children.summary: Completed media needed reliable multi-platform publication without manual handling.

children.title: formula.event_pipeline.action.2
children.summary: Built an event-driven and scheduled pipeline across Python jobs, Google Drive, n8n, external APIs, grounded LLM generation, and publishing endpoints.

children.title: formula.event_pipeline.output.3
children.summary: Added durable posted-state markers, scheduled recovery, retry backoff, strict JSON contracts, and diagnostic failure links.

children.title: formula.event_pipeline.outcome.4
children.summary: Automated asset-to-publication handling while preventing duplicate publication and making failures diagnosable.

children.title: formula.workflow_generator.action.1
children.summary: Built a Claude-assisted generator for complete importable n8n workflow JSON aligned with established credential conventions.

children.title: formula.workflow_generator.output.2
children.summary: Reused the generation approach across two production systems and more than 23 workflows.

children.title: formula.workflow_generator.outcome.3
children.summary: Reduced idea-to-running-workflow time to under 10 minutes.

children.title: formula.event_templates.action.1
children.summary: Built parameterized templates that wait for live event state and combine results, statistics, commentary, context, AI-generated copy, and publishing.

children.title: formula.event_templates.output.2
children.summary: Passed changing event context as data through one maintained template.

children.title: formula.event_templates.outcome.3
children.summary: Replaced event-by-event recreation with a reusable data-driven workflow.

children.title: formula.information_aggregation.action.1
children.summary: Built a recurring pipeline that collected and processed information from heterogeneous community and web sources.

children.title: formula.information_aggregation.output.2
children.summary: Created a consolidated information layer refreshed at an approximately daily cadence.

children.title: formula.information_aggregation.outcome.3
children.summary: Replaced dependence on a single feed with recurring multi-source ingestion.

children.title: formula.formulytics.action.1
children.summary: Built and operated the Formulytics presence and its automated operating system.

children.title: formula.formulytics.outcome.2
children.summary: Supported audience scale of 200M+ cumulative Instagram views, roughly 20M monthly Facebook views at peak, and 30K Instagram followers.

children.title: think.context_memory.action.1
children.summary: Built a context-aware LLM conversation system with persistent memory, confidence handling, ACE context, and personalized behavior.

children.title: think.context_memory.output.2
children.summary: Combined Python, FastAPI, asynchronous services, APIs, orchestration, and multi-provider evaluation in a retained-context conversation path.

children.title: think.context_memory.outcome.3
children.summary: Produced a core architecture suitable for continued developer work and pilot preparation.

children.title: think.context_memory.status.4
children.summary: The product remained under mental-health board review and was not clinically validated or approved.

children.title: think.safety_evaluation.action.1
children.summary: Built a bounded fail-closed response path that generates, parses, evaluates, and releases only output that passes safety checks.

children.title: think.safety_evaluation.output.2
children.summary: Implemented harmful-content filtering, crisis detection and routing, professional boundaries, minor-user protections, and layered controls.

children.title: think.safety_evaluation.outcome.3
children.summary: Preserved conversational responsiveness while checking model output before it reached a vulnerable user.

children.title: think.safety_evaluation.status.4
children.summary: The safety design was ready for review and pilot preparation; it did not establish clinical efficacy.

children.title: think.multi_agent_platform.action.1
children.summary: Contributed to platform architecture for parallel development of healing, onboarding, FAQ, and storytelling agents.

children.title: think.multi_agent_platform.output.2
children.summary: Separated specialized agent responsibilities within a shared platform direction.

children.title: think.multi_agent_platform.status.3
children.summary: Zoe reached board review; the other specialized agents were still under construction.

children.title: cognizant.ingestion.action.1
children.summary: Built automated Python, SQL, Apache Spark, and PySpark-style data-ingestion pipelines.

children.title: cognizant.ingestion.output.2
children.summary: Fed downstream KPI and analytics workflows with production-scale transformed data.

children.title: cognizant.ingestion.outcome.3
children.summary: Maintained ingestion at more than 50 million rows per day.

children.title: cognizant.kpi_latency.action.1
children.summary: Optimized the path from source data through downstream KPI delivery.

children.title: cognizant.kpi_latency.outcome.2
children.summary: Reduced data-to-KPI latency from roughly 48 hours to roughly 2 hours.

children.title: cognizant.aws_etl.action.1
children.summary: Optimized ETL workflows using AWS S3, Lambda, and Glue.

children.title: cognizant.aws_etl.outcome.2
children.summary: Reduced infrastructure cost measurably without a confirmed exact percentage or amount.

children.title: cognizant.data_quality.action.1
children.summary: Used data validation and pipeline testing with explicit transformations and downstream KPI dependencies.

children.title: cognizant.data_quality.output.2
children.summary: Built production experience in throughput, cloud ETL, distributed processing, and maintainable data contracts.
